observations: Photo 0 shows a cordless drill with a black and red body, held in hand. The battery pack is labeled '21V MAX LITHIUM'. The chuck has speed settings marked 18-15-17-19-22.
Photo 1 shows the same drill from a different angle, with the chuck speed settings visible: 18-15-17-19-22. The drill appears to be in used condition with some dirt and wear.

Photo 2 shows the drill inside its open black plastic case, with the battery, drill body, and various bits and accessories. The case has molded slots for bits and a handle. The drill is not plugged in or powered on.
The drill has a red trigger and a red button on the battery pack. The chuck is black with a textured grip.
The case appears to be a standard 12-bit or 16-bit cordless drill case, but the number of bits is not clearly visible in the photos.
